Title: General availability: Azure Queue Storage SDK for Go

Body.Content:
We are announcing the general availability of the Azure Queue Storage SDK for Go.

This new SDK allows developers to build Go applications that can store large numbers of messages on Azure Queue Storage. Developers can access these stored messages from anywhere in the world via authenticated calls using this SDK. The SDK has been modernized to follow the Azure SDK guidelines and be idiomatic for Go.

Read the announcement blog post for more details and to get started.
